meaning:
1) to pluck off or out, cut off
1a) (Qal) to pluck off
1b) (Niphal) to be plucked off

elsewhere.note: When you come into your neighbor’s standing grain, then you may pluck the ears with your hand; but you shall not use a sickle on your neighbor’s standing grain.
While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.
He cropped off the topmost of its young twigs, and carried it to a land of traffic. He planted it in a city of merchants.
